new_destinations.name: Mamanuca Islands
new_destinations.coordinates_source: centre of the named place/region (town centre or middle of its spots); to be confirmed with resolve-pin.py

name_evidence.wording: Wikivoyage page "Mamanuca Islands" (region of resort and day-trip islands off Denarau).

spots.name: Monuriki
spots.bio_draft: Uninhabited island: the Cast Away filming island (2000 film), with white beaches and a pine forest; Wikivoyage calls it very much off the beaten track.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Mamanuca Islands and reached from that base.

spots.name: Mana Island
spots.bio_draft: Island resort: three beach areas, lagoon snorkelling and water sports; a Survivor filming location.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Mamanuca Islands and reached from that base.

spots.name: Beachcomber Island
spots.bio_draft: Island resort: a private island with a backpacker resort, snorkelling, dive shop and the nightly Bula Dance; reached from Denarau by catamaran.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Mamanuca Islands and reached from that base.

spots.name: Treasure Island
spots.bio_draft: Island resort: a marine reserve island with palm beaches, snorkelling, a turtle restoration programme and family facilities.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Mamanuca Islands and reached from that base.

spots.name: South Sea Island
spots.bio_draft: Island resort: a 30-minute day trip from Denarau with a pool, snorkel gear, kayaks and a semi-submersible coral viewer.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Mamanuca Islands and reached from that base.

spots.name: Bounty Island
spots.bio_draft: Island: a marine-reserve island (Bounty Island, Kadavulailai) with white beaches, a small resort and snorkelling.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Mamanuca Islands and reached from that base.

spots.name: Cloudbreak
spots.bio_draft: Surf break: the headline reef wave off Tavarua, a world-class right in the southern Mamanucas (no article of its own; Wikipedia Cloudbreak redirects to Tavarua).
spots.reason: Inside the span of Mamanuca Islands and reached from that base.
